title: RNAi screens in C. elegans in a 96-well liquid format and their application to the systematic identification of genetic interactions
protocol: Replicate RNAi library bacterial glycerol stocks onto LB plus Ampicillin plates.
Grow overnight at 37°C.
Inoculate bacteria into 400 μl to 800 μl of 2×TY plus 100 μg/ml ampicillin, depending on the final volume required.
Grow overnight in a shaking incubator at 37°C.
Add IPTG to each well of bacterial cultures to achieve a final concentration of 4 mM.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Pellet bacteria by spinning at 3500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Re-suspend bacteria in an equal volume of single peptone plus 100 μg/ml ampicillin plus 4 mM IPTG.
Filter mixed stage or starved populations of worms through a 10 μm mesh in M9 buffer to isolate L1 stage worms.
Centrifuge isolated worms through a 10 μm mesh for 10 seconds at 1,000 rpm to prepare L1s by centrifugation method.
Prepare L1s by bleaching gravid adults on the previous day and hatching overnight in M9 buffer.
Resuspend L1 worms at a concentration of approximately 10 L1 worms per 10 μl of M9 buffer.
Pipette approximately 10 L1 worms in a volume of 10 μl of M9 buffer into each well of a 96-well plate using a multichannel pipette.
Agitate the plastic tray while pipetting to avoid settling of worms.
Mix equal volumes of each bacterial feeding clone in each well (20 μl of each strain).
Incubate worms in a shaking incubator for 4 days at 20°C.
Stack 96-well plates in plastic containers within the incubator to prevent evaporation.
Score plates on a dissecting microscope 4 days after setup.
Evaluate embryonic lethality (Emb phenotype) and sterility (Ste) semi-quantitatively on a scale from 0 (wild-type) to 3 (100% Emb or Ste).
Compare RNAi phenotypes observed in mutant worm strains with those in wild-type worms fed control bacterial strains.
Replicate any putative phenotypes and genetic interactions observed.
Replicate bacterial glycerol stocks onto plates.
Grow overnight at day -2 (or earlier).
Grow bacteria overnight at day -1 (optional: bleach worm strains and hatch overnight in M9).
Induce bacteria on day 0.
Filter worms on day 0.
Add L1 worms and bacteria to 96-well plates on day 0.
Incubate in shaker on day 0.
Score plates on day 4.
Re-score plates on day 5.
